text: German is spoken in several countries, and greetings vary by region. You will hear all of these, and Hallo and Guten Tag work everywhere.

• Moin – northern Germany, any time of day.
  • Grüß Gott – Bavaria and Austria.
  • Servus – Bavaria and Austria, informal; both hello and goodbye.
  • Grüezi – German-speaking Switzerland.
You do not need to use these yourself yet: recognise them, and answer with the same word or with Guten Tag.
